data.name: ACCRETION
data.detailed_description:
ACCRETION is a fast-paced 2D space combat arena where up to 4 players battle in intense round-based dogfights. Master seven unique weapon systems, earn devastating upgrades, and prove you're the ultimate pilot.

Core Gameplay

Fight until only one ship survives. The last pilot standing wins the round and earns a point. Between rounds, choose from powerful upgrades that stack and evolve your playstyle. First to reach the target score wins the match.

Seven Distinct Weapons

  • Default Cannon - Reliable rapid-fire with spread options

  • Grenade Launcher - Arc explosive shots with cluster and sticky variants

  • Flak Cannon - Devastating close-range shotgun blasts

  • Salvo Missiles - Lock-on tracking projectiles with burst fire

  • Charged Beam - Devastating laser that tracks your target

  • Heated Thrust - Ram enemies while leaving a deadly flame trail

  • Piercer - High-speed ram attacks with health regeneration

Strategic Upgrade System

After each round, eliminated players choose from randomized upgrades:

  • Damage boosts and fire rate increases

  • Shield generators and protective auras

  • Health regeneration and piercing shots

  • Movement speed and thrust enhancements

  • Weapon-specific modifiers that transform your loadout

Every decision matters. Build synergies or adapt to counter your opponents.

Key Features

✦ Online Multiplayer - 2-4 players via Steam
✦ Round-Based Combat - Quick, intense battles with no downtime
✦ Progressive Upgrades - Grow stronger each round
✦ Screen-Wrapping Arena - Classic asteroid-style positioning
✦ Color-Coded Ships - Track your rivals in the chaos
✦ Balanced Weapons - Every choice is viable

Perfect For

  • Quick competitive sessions with friends

  • Couch multiplayer parties

  • Roguelike progression fans

  • Classic arcade enthusiasts

Master your weapon. Outsmart your opponents. Dominate the arena.
